canonical_statement: Every vacuum Einstein initial data set satisfying the constraint equations admits a maximal globally hyperbolic development, unique up to an initial-data-preserving isometry.
domain_and_universes: A smooth 3-manifold S with Riemannian metric h and symmetric second fundamental form K satisfying the vacuum Einstein constraint equations; developments are time-oriented Lorentzian 4-manifolds with an embedding of S. Exact Lean universes and regularity classes remain to be frozen.
quantifiers: for every admissible vacuum initial data set (S, h, K)
there exists a development (M, g, i)
for every other globally hyperbolic development (M', g', i')
hypotheses: developments solve the vacuum Einstein equations and induce (h, K) on the embedded Cauchy surface
conclusion: There is a maximal globally hyperbolic development, and any two maximal developments are related by an isometry commuting with the initial-surface embeddings.
